item.title: Algolia Enhances Shopify Integration
item.description: Algolia expanded customisation within Shopify App Blocks, giving merchants greater control over how search behaves without requiring a storefront rebuild.

item.title: Idomoo Introduces Strata
item.description: Strata not only generates separate layers for text, animation, footage and actors — it designs the full composition, defining placement, contrast, movement, timing and pacing across all layers, all while enforcing nuanced brand guidelines.

item.title: Keenfolks Introduces KEENFOLKS X_
item.description: The network is built on K OS_, Keenfolks’ proprietary marketing operating system, which connects intelligence, data, automation, and execution into reusable marketing systems.

item.title: Multiply Raises $9.5M for Self-Learning Ads
item.description: As new AI-powered advertising channels emerge, Multiply aims to help customers adopt them early while continuing to outperform across existing platforms.

item.title: Topsort Launches Tomi to Automate Retail Media Campaign Operations
item.description: The launch reinforces Topsort's mission to build AI-native retail media infrastructure that helps enterprise marketplaces scale advertising programs without the complexity of legacy ad tech.

item.title: Transcend Introduces Agentic Assist and MCP Server
item.description: New products by Transcend make it easier than ever for privacy teams to automate compliance workflows, reducing days of manual work to minutes of guided review.

item.title: Upland Software Launches Second Street’s Text-to-Vote Feature
item.description: The Text‑to‑Vote capability enables users to boost audience participation, streamline mobile‑first voting experiences, and unlock new advertiser revenue opportunities through a frictionless SMS workflow.

item.title: Vibe Marketing Tech Fest Returns to Manchester for Second Annual
item.description: The summit will focus on proving the impact of marketing spend and using analytics to add customer value. It brings together leaders across marketing, CX, and technology to share real-world experiences and insights on navigating tech stack challenges

item.title: Samsung Ads Launches TotalView for Unified TV Ad Reach Measurement
item.description: Powered by insights from Samsung Smart TVs, TotalView gives advertisers a unified view of reach across linear and streaming, enabling smarter planning, precise targeting, and more holistic campaign measurement.

item.title: Alchemer Launches AI Auto-Responder
item.description: With AI Auto-Responder, businesses can accelerate response times, enhance customer perception and maintain consistent brand voice, while reducing manual effort and enabling teams to focus on higher-value strategic work.

item.title: Middle East Subscription App Growth Shifts across Categories and Platforms
item.description: New data shows Short Drama emerging as one of the UAE’s fastest-growing subscription categories and a top destination for Android ad spend, signalling a shift in how audiences consume and pay for mobile content

item.title: SHE Media, Mirror Digital Partner to Expand Inclusive Media Reach
item.description: The alliance brings together Mirror Digital's cultural authority and creator-led storytelling expertise with SHE Media's premium inventory and first-party audience data capabilities.

item.title: Impartner Unifies Partner Marketing Automation with AI and AdTech
item.description: Through its predictive AI integration, Impartner enables fully automated optimisation across keywords, bids, audiences, and budgets using the big data and conversion data from all partner campaigns together across all geographics.

item.title: Netcore Unbxd Unveils Agentic Multimodal Search Capability
item.description: Netcore Unbxd's Agentic multimodal introduces a unified approach that allows shoppers to upload an image and refine it with language prompts.

item.title: Storyblok Introduces FlowMotion
item.description: FlowMotion turns events in Storyblok, such as create, update, approve, translate, schedule, and publish, into workflows that can sequence actions, pause for human approvals, enforce governance rules, and execute only where relevant.
